messages:
nina: Hey team — we're getting a customer escalation for p99 latency on /v1/generate in us-west after today's runtime rollout. They report spikes at ~20:00 UTC. I can share graphs. :frowning:

kevin: Thanks. Which rollout? Canary for runtime v3.2.0-rc2 went live at 19:40 UTC. Any canary anomalies?

nina: Yes, canary was ~19:40. I pulled APM traces — p50 fine, p95 up 320ms -> 700ms, p99 up to 2.1s. Sample trace id 0x8f2a. Customer: AcmeApps.

sam: :eyes: Looking at infra metrics now. Running query against metrics DB:
```
SELECT quantile(0.95)(latency_ms), quantile(0.99)(latency_ms) FROM http_requests
WHERE path='/v1/generate' AND region='us-west' AND ts > '2026-03-16T19:00:00Z'
GROUP BY rollout_tag
```

sam: Results show spike coincident with rollout_tag=runtime-v3.2.0-rc2, p99 ~2100ms. Canary group nodes show higher queue_depth on hotpath.

carla: Any kernel-selector or routing changes in this build? We changed async-queueing thresholds and enabled kernel selector heuristic 'hot-routing' in rc2.

kevin: That matches. Hypothesis: new routing heuristic pushes some requests to slow-path kernels under certain seq len distribution.

nina: Customer repro steps: batch_size=1, seq_len ~1024, "temperature":0.7. They see p99 spikes reproducible.

sam: I can reproduce on a canary node with load test. Starting test now with seq_len 1024, concurrency 4.

sam: Repro'd. Profiling shows periods where kernel fallback happens: kernel_selector chose int8-fallback which adds 600-800ms.

kevin: Ok, bisect plan: (1) roll-back kernel selector change on one canary pool; (2) rerun load; (3) if resolved, schedule rollback. Can we hotpatch config first?

carla: Patching config now to disable 'hot-routing' on canary pool id cp-03. Command:
```
redwoodctl pool config set cp-03 --kernel-selector=legacy --rolling 1
```

carla: Patch applied. Waiting for pool to warm.

sam: Rerunning load. p95 back to baseline ~280ms, p99 down to 480ms. Looks much better.

nina: Customer confirmed lower latency after we routed their tenancy to legacy selector. :tada: 

kevin: Good. Root cause narrowed to kernel-selector heuristics interacting with long-seq single-token batch workloads.

kevin: Mitigation: immediate - pin affected customers to legacy selector via routing rules. Short term - revert heuristic in next hotfix. Medium - add rollout canary that exercises long-seq single-batch hotpath.

nina: I'll coordinate with support to roll customer pin and notify them. Sam, can you open a postmortem ticket with steps and metrics snapshots?

sam: Will do. Ticket #INC-4621. Adding links to traces and the query. Also recommend adding an e2e perf test with seq_len 1024.

carla: Also will add gating to kernel-selector rollout: require <5% fallback rate in staged load tests.

kevin: Thanks all. Logging followups:
- revert heuristic PR: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/3142
- inc ticket: INC-4621
- canary pool id: cp-03

nina: Great. Marking thread resolved unless anything else. :white_check_mark:
